name: Azure MCP Server
description: Gives AI agents MCP tools to query and manage Azure services such as Storage, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, AKS, and Azure Monitor using your Azure identity.

skills.name: Azure Storage
skills.description: Lists and creates storage accounts, inspects blob containers, and uploads files to blob storage from natural-language prompts.

skills.name: Cosmos DB Queries
skills.description: Lists Cosmos DB databases and containers, infers container schemas, and searches documents by field value or vector similarity.

skills.name: Key Vault Management
skills.description: Lists and creates Key Vault secrets and keys, and lists or imports certificates in a named vault using your Azure credentials.

skills.name: AKS And Monitor
skills.description: Lists AKS clusters and node pools, and queries Log Analytics tables and Azure Monitor health models for operational insight.
